name: MACRO
full_name: Monopole, Astrophysics and Cosmic Ray Observatory
summary: A multipurpose Gran Sasso underground detector combined tracking and timing to search for monopoles, study cosmic-ray muons and measure atmospheric neutrinos.
detection_principle: Streamer tubes reconstructed tracks while scintillation counters supplied timing for upward/downward discrimination. Nuclear track detectors supplemented searches for highly ionising particles.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: LNGS explicitly dates MACRO operation to 1989–2000.

collaboration.name: MACRO Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Structure
key_parameters.value: Six supermodules combining scintillator, streamer tubes and track detectors

key_parameters.name: Overburden
key_parameters.value: Approximately 3,700 m water equivalent at Gran Sasso

results.summary: Upgoing muon distributions and energy-dependent studies supported muon-neutrino oscillations.
Point-source and rare-particle searches produced limits rather than established new sources or monopoles.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
